annotations.title: United Kingdom: full income tax return 2026-27

description: The complete United Kingdom income tax computation for 2026-27, as on the return. Covers: England, Wales and Northern Ireland bands and the Scottish bands, Personal Allowance taper above £100,000; Marriage Allowance (transfer or receive), Blind Person's Allowance, Gift Aid and relief-at-source band extension; Employment with benefits in kind, expenses, salary sacrifice and net pay; Class 1 NI (and employer NI as cost); Self-employment with the trading allowance, losses brought forward, Class 4 and voluntary Class 2 NI; Property income: property allowance, Rent a Room, losses, the 20% finance-cost reduction with carry-forward; and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in GBP; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

inputSchema.description: An individual's UK income tax return (Self Assessment), tax year 2026-27 (6 April 2026 – 5 April 2027). Every amount is in pounds for the whole year; leave out what does not apply.

allowance_as_non_resident.description: Non-resident entitled to the Personal Allowance (British or EEA citizen, Crown servant, or under a tax treaty). Default true

capital_gains.description: Disposals of shares, property, crypto and other assets

costs.description: Costs of buying, improving and selling, pounds for the tax year

proceeds.description: Sale proceeds, pounds for the tax year

relief.description: Private residence relief (PRR) or other relief, pounds for the tax year

type.description: residential (homes, buy-to-let), other (shares, funds, crypto...), badr (qualifying business disposal)

loss_brought_forward.description: Capital losses brought forward, pounds for the tax year

dividends.description: Foreign dividends, pounds for the tax year

fig_claim.description: Claim the 4-year foreign income and gains regime (first 4 years of UK residence after 10 years abroad)

gains.description: Net gains on foreign assets, pounds for the tax year

interest.description: Foreign interest, pounds for the tax year

other.description: Foreign rent, pensions and other income, pounds for the tax year

gift_aid.description: Gift Aid donations (the amount you paid), pounds for the tax year

payments_on_account.description: Payments on account made for 2026-27 (31 January and 31 July 2027), pounds for the tax year

carry_forward.description: Unused annual allowance from the previous 3 years, pounds for the tax year

mpaa.description: Pension flexibly accessed: £10,000 money purchase annual allowance

net_pay.description: Contributions taken from pay before tax (net pay), pounds for the tax year

relief_at_source_net.description: Personal contributions paid net to a relief-at-source scheme, pounds for the tax year

expenses.description: Allowable expenses, without mortgage interest, pounds for the tax year

finance_costs_brought_forward.description: Unused finance costs brought forward, pounds for the tax year

loss_brought_forward.description: Property losses brought forward, pounds for the tax year

rent.description: Rent received, pounds for the tax year

region.description: Where you live: england, wales, ni (Northern Ireland) or scotland (Scottish rates on non-savings income). Default england

dividends.description: UK dividends (not ISA), pounds for the tax year

interest.description: Interest (not ISA), pounds for the tax year

expenses.description: Allowable expenses, pounds for the tax year

loss_brought_forward.description: Trading losses brought forward, pounds for the tax year

srt.description: Statutory residence test facts (optional): decide residence from days and ties

full_time_work_uk.description: Full-time work in the UK for a 365-day period

only_home_in_uk.description: Your only home is in the UK (91 consecutive days, at least 30 in the year)

resident_in_previous_3.description: UK resident in one or more of the 3 previous tax years
